notes: Summary: Quarry Logic operates a fleet orchestration platform with 24/7 chat for drivers and a reranking pipeline for manifests. Primary ask: predictable token/sec & throughput guarantees to avoid incidents during peak dispatch windows.
Workload shape: steady-state: weekday daytime 25 QPS (low token payloads), nightly background embedding refreshes; peak bursts: up to ~250 QPS during dispatch surges (~10x steady).

Token estimates: typical driver chat session = 150 tokens request + 80 tokens generation = ~230 tokens per call; reranking flows send batches of 10 docs (~1.6k tokens) for scoring. Est baseline tokens/sec target: 12,000 tps; peak target: 120,000 tps. (Customer provided telemetry, see Drive: sizing-raw.csv)

Latency SLOs: driver chat p95 < 250ms; p99 < 500ms for short-turn queries. Reranking acceptable p95 < 700ms (batch scoring). Request fallback policy required if latency breach > 300ms for p99 — must route to smaller quantized model or cached prefix response.
Desired SLA: 99.95% availability for Dedicated pool, p99 latency SLOs with credits; Redwood asked for draft SLA addendum for legal review.

GPU preference: leaning toward 8x H100-equivalent reserved for headroom, but cost team is pushing A100-80G to save costs; SE recommended mixed pool with H100 for low-latency interactive inference and A100 for heavy batched reranking.

Operational asks: autoscaling burst to public burst capacity, strict VPC peering and private control plane, per-route token-level cost breakdown in console, audit logs for retention 7 years (regulatory), SSO/SAML and SCIM provisioning.
Quote sensitivity: procurement wants 12-month commit; finance asks for quarterly true-ups instead of annual prepaid.
Customer comment: 'we need guarantees for peak dispatch windows — last quarter we dropped 12% of messages during morning surge' (CTO).
